Malicious compose fixtures for the lint (05-engineering, security tests).
Each section is one compose file; the second field of its header is the
finding ID the lint must report; a trailing * matches any suffix (mount
IDs end in a hash of what they mount).

-- privileged web/privileged --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    privileged: true
-- pid-host web/pid --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    pid: host
-- network-host web/network_mode --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    network_mode: host
-- ipc-host web/ipc --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    ipc: host
-- userns-host web/userns_mode --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    userns_mode: host
-- docker-sock web/volumes/_var_run_docker.sock-* --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
-- docker-sock-elsewhere web/volumes/_var_run_docker.sock-* --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - ./docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
-- etc-mount web/volumes/_host-etc-* --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /etc
        target: /host-etc
-- proc-mount web/volumes/_host-proc-* --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - ./src:/src
      - /proc:/host-proc
-- outside-root web/volumes/_stolen-* --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - ../../../../../../../../../home:/stolen:ro
-- host-root web/volumes/_host-* --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes:
      - /:/host
-- cap-sys-admin web/cap_add/SYS_ADMIN --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    cap_add: [SYS_ADMIN]
-- cap-all web/cap_add/ALL --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    cap_add: [ALL]
-- cap-net-admin-prefixed web/cap_add/NET_ADMIN --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    cap_add: [CAP_NET_ADMIN]
-- seccomp-unconfined web/security_opt/seccomp_unconfined --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    security_opt: ["seccomp=unconfined"]
-- apparmor-unconfined web/security_opt/apparmor_unconfined --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    security_opt: ["apparmor:unconfined"]
-- devices web/devices/_dev_kmsg__dev_kmsg --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    devices: ["/dev/kmsg:/dev/kmsg"]
-- named-volume-bind volumes/data-* --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes: [data:/data]
volumes:
  data:
    driver: local
    driver_opts: {type: none, o: bind, device: /var/lib/docker}
-- env-interpolation web/volumes/_home-* --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes: ["${HOME}:/home"]
-- second-service db/privileged --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
  db:
    image: postgres
    privileged: true
-- volumes-from-container web/volumes_from/container_icaro-agent --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes_from: ["container:icaro-agent"]
-- volumes-from-unknown web/volumes_from/agent_ro --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    volumes_from: ["agent:ro"]
-- pid-container web/pid/container_icaro-agent --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    pid: container:icaro-agent
-- network-container web/network_mode/container_icaro-traefik-1234 --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    network_mode: "container:icaro-traefik-1234"
-- ipc-container web/ipc/container_x --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    ipc: container:x
-- uts-unknown-service web/uts/service_ghost --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    uts: service:ghost
-- preview-network-external networks/icaro-preview --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    networks: [pn]
networks:
  pn:
    external: true
    name: icaro-preview
-- preview-network-key networks/icaro-preview --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    networks: [icaro-preview]
networks:
  icaro-preview:
    external: true
-- preview-network-named networks/icaro-other-0123abcd_default --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
networks:
  default:
    name: icaro-other-0123abcd_default
-- preview-network-undeclared web/networks/icaro-preview --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    networks: [icaro-preview]
-- preview-alias web/networks/aliases/icaro-other-0123abcd-web --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    networks:
      default:
        aliases: [icaro-other-0123abcd-web]
-- preview-service-name icaro-other-0123abcd-web/service_name --
services:
  icaro-other-0123abcd-web:
    image: nginx
-- preview-container-name web/container_name/icaro-other-0123abcd-web --
services:
  web:
    image: nginx
    container_name: icaro-other-0123abcd-web
